exposure: Women with adequate knowledge on mode of delivery
CS delivery in the previous pregnancy
Women lacking adequate knowledge on mode of delivery
cohort: 1303 pregnant women in the United Arab Emirates
finding: The study found a lack of adequate knowledge about mode of delivery among pregnant women and identified age, employment, and previous cesarean delivery as factors associated with preference for cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Age, employment status, and previous cesarean delivery were associated with a preference towards cesarean delivery.
